open_questions: Was the lisinopril dose increased from 10 mg to 20 mg, and if so, when and why?
What was the patient's blood pressure before starting lisinopril?
Has dizziness or hypotension been documented previously on lisinopril or other antihypertensives?
Are there any documented allergies or adverse reactions to ACE inhibitors?
What follow-up actions were taken or planned after the dizziness episode (e.g., BP monitoring, dose adjustment, discontinuation)?

citation.quote: Conflicting dose facts for lisinopril: 10mg versus 20mg.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Dose discrepancy may indicate unintentional doubling or prescribing error, increasing risk of hypotension.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Clarify current prescribed lisinopril dose and reconcile with pharmacy records and patient instructions.

citation.quote: Patient describes new dizziness after lisinopril 20 mg morning dose. Home blood pressure was 98/62 mmHg.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Symptomatic hypotension (dizziness + BP 98/62) suggests possible overdose or sensitivity to lisinopril.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Hold lisinopril until dose reconciliation and clinical assessment; consider BP recheck and orthostatic evaluation.
